# has sequence coordinates

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:hasSequenceCoordinates`](gmeow-hasSequenceCoordinates.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/hasSequenceCoordinates>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/places`](../../slices/places.md)

Links a sequence feature to its frame-relative coordinates. Non-functional: competing coordinate claims from different assemblies or alignment methods coexist as evidence ([Principle 9](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-9)).
